# Vendored front-end libraries

Kept in the repo so the page works without internet access. Exact versions:

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `niivue-0.69.0.esm.js` | `@niivue/niivue` 0.69.0 (npm). The self-contained ES module, URL-decoded from the package's `build/index.min.js` (which wraps it in an `esm` string export). | BSD-2-Clause, `LICENSE-niivue` |
| `marked-18.0.13.esm.js` | `marked` 18.0.13, `lib/marked.esm.js` | MIT, `LICENSE-marked` |
| `purify-3.4.15.es.mjs` | `dompurify` 3.4.15, `dist/purify.es.mjs` | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0, `LICENSE-dompurify` |

Source-map comments were removed. The icons in `../icons.js` follow the style of Feather icons (MIT).
